properties.name: A1450/26 / TUPJ
properties.originalText:
HELIPAD RESTRICTED TO TLOF OPERATIONS ONLY. FATO WITHDRAWN. RWY
LANDING FOLLOWED BY CONTROLLED GROUND MOVEMENT AND SHORT HOVER
REPOSITION TO A DESIGNATED TLOF.
NO SIMULTANEOUS OPERATIONS FOR HELICOPTERS AT HELIPADS.
NO SIMULTANEOUS TAXIING BETWEEN HELICOPTERS AT THE HELIPAD AND
AIRCRAFT SOUTH AND WEST OF THE HELIPADS INTENDING TO USE THE D4
TAXILANE.
NO SIMULTANEOUS OPERATION FOR HELICOPTERS AT THE HELIPADS AND
AIRCRAFT SOUTH OF THE HELIPAD
MAXIMUM HELICOPTER D-VALUE IS 12M.
DAYLIGHT OPERATION ONLY.
MARSHALLING REQUIRED FOR HELICOPTER MOVEMENTS.
UNEVEN SURFACE AT HELIPADS. ALL ACFT ARE TO EXERCISE CAUTION.
properties.source: FAA NMS — PRODUCTION / 本番環境
